meta.deck_title: From Field Evidence to Better Agro Decisions
meta.audience_ja: 月例のAdmin Meeting。全部署の統括メンバーが参加する。毎月午前9時開始。
meta.time_slot_ja: 持ち時間は未確定。秒数は発表者ノートの語数（毎分130語）から出した読み上げの目安で、割り当てではない。
meta.title_note_ja: 題名は「現場の証拠 → より良い農業の判断」という流れをそのまま示す。成果が出たとは言わず、副題は「could mean」で止めている。

slides.title: From Field Evidence to Better Agro Decisions
slides.takeaway: What I saw, recorded and researched, and what it could mean for each team
slides.purpose_ja: 発表の約束を示す。現場・記録・調査を、判断につなげる話だと最初に伝える。
lines: Agro Team update · Admin Meeting · October 2026

slides.title: My work at a glance
slides.takeaway: Six pieces of work, each linked to a decision it could inform.
slides.purpose_ja: 6件の仕事と、それぞれが役立つ判断を1枚で見せる。時間が足りないときは、この1枚で現場の4件を済ませられる。
lines: Cattle records / Land survey / Soil testing / Harvest trial / Cold-chain research / Daily-information tools
Right column: the decision each piece could inform

slides.title: Cattle records
slides.takeaway: One sheet lets us compare animals before deciding which to sell.
slides.purpose_ja: 牛の情報を1つの表にそろえると、売る牛の判断に使えることを示す。柵と見回りの印象は「私の見方」として分けて出す。
lines: DID: entered 45 head into one sheet (pregnancy status, expected sale price, milk performance)
PURPOSE: identify animals that could be sold, as a source of cash
OBSERVED: noticed possible gaps in fencing and monitoring (impression from inside the pen)
slides.decision_ja: 売却する牛の選定と、柵と見回りの確認
asks: Is there a fence-repair or herd-count routine I should learn about?

slides.title: Land survey
slides.takeaway: A plot that looks promising on the map still needs a check on the ground.
slides.purpose_ja: 地図で有望でも、現地で危険や使いにくさが見つかった経験から、現地確認の項目を決める提案につなげる。
lines: DID: walked candidate plots with the team and helped measure the land
OBSERVED: buffalo at some places; dense, thin trees at others
MY VIEW: both made some locations risky to use, although the map did not show it
slides.decision_ja: 候補地の選定と安全確認
asks: Do we use a site checklist today? What would you add?

slides.title: Annual soil testing
slides.takeaway: Spreading a termite treatment does not confirm the termites are gone.
slides.purpose_ja: 散布したことと効いたことは別、という観察を1件の事実として出す。原因は言い切らず、記録の取り方を提案する。
lines: DID: joined the once-a-year soil test
OBSERVED: termites still in the soil after a treatment had been spread
MY VIEW: one observation; cause unknown (timing, product or coverage)
slides.decision_ja: 害虫対策のあとの確認方法
asks: Who tracks pest-control results today? Could we log where and when each treatment is spread?

slides.title: Avocado harvest trial
slides.takeaway: A two-group comparison tests whether containers make yield easier to measure.
slides.purpose_ja: 収穫班を2つに分けて比べる方法を紹介する。結果の数値は同僚の成果で、共有済みなので載せない。
lines: METHOD: harvest crew split in two; one group used harvest containers, the other did not
COMPARED: yield measured, and how efficiently each group worked
RESULT: already shared with the team; not repeated here
slides.decision_ja: 収量の測り方と作業効率の見方
asks: Which yield figures would your team want from each harvest?
slides.blocker_ja: 結果の数値を載せるか未決（Q04）。自分の役割も未確認。

slides.title: My research: cold chains for export
slides.takeaway: Public data becomes questions we can test in the field.
slides.purpose_ja: 調査の進め方（集める、1事実1枚、現地で聞く）と、代表の数字を1つ示す。
lines: Question: can better cold chains help East African produce reach export markets?
Three steps: collect, one fact per slide, ask in the field
Chart: Tanzania's avocado export value, USD million, 2015-2024 (FAOSTAT, calendar year, nominal)
2019 to 2024: 9.0M to 49.8M (5.6 times); 5th of 8 in 2024 among avocado and 7 traditional export crops
slides.decision_ja: 輸出の計画と、現地ヒアリングの準備

slides.title: Where public sources disagree or stop
slides.takeaway: Three things to check before we rely on the numbers.
slides.purpose_ja: 公式の数字でも食い違うこと、設備の発表と実際の利用は別なこと、新しい規則が収穫に関わることを、「報告されたこと」と「まだ分からないこと」に分けて示す。
lines: How big is the crop? Two official production figures differ about five times (different years and methods); the 19% export share depends on the choice
Is the cold chain ready? Facilities are reported by government or operators; no independent data on use
A new rule touches our harvest: Avocado Crop Management Regulations (April 2026); enforcement is a question for the regulator
slides.decision_ja: 生産量の見積り。収穫から冷却までの時間の確認

slides.title: Making daily information easier to see
slides.takeaway: A first prototype shows what a shared view of daily conditions could look like.
slides.purpose_ja: 構想（天気・電気・車の位置）と試作（コーヒーベッドの表示）を区別する。必要な情報と記録の手間を聞く。
lines: Weather and power: idea / Vehicle GPS: idea / Coffee drying beds: prototype
The bed dashboard is built from a CSV snapshot and does not update live
slides.decision_ja: 日々の計画に必要な情報
asks: Which daily information would help your team most, and how can we record it without extra work?

slides.title: What this could mean for each team
slides.takeaway: The labels are my own grouping. Please tell me where your team fits.
slides.purpose_ja: 部署ごとに「気づいたこと」と「聞きたいこと」を並べ、会議で具体的な助言をもらう。部署名は仮の分け方。
lines: Six rows: field operations, livestock, export and logistics, finance and planning, data and tools, sales and brand
slides.blocker_ja: 部署名が仮（Q03）。最終行（日本のカフェへの紹介）を残すか未決（Q06）。

slides.title: Coming up
slides.purpose_ja: 次にやること（コーヒー摘み、ナイロビの現地ヒアリング、今日の助言の反映）で締める。
lines: Coffee picking, goal: three buckets
Nairobi field interviews, 14 October
Your advice, today

slides.title: Where is Tanzania's avocado grown?
slides.takeaway: Kilimanjaro led reported household production in 2023/24; Mbeya led the Southern Highlands.
slides.purpose_ja: 質問が出たときの補足。原本で画像の下に隠れていた地図を復元した。
lines: Regional map and table from the national statistics survey 2023/24 (farming households only)

slides.title: Sources and definitions
slides.takeaway: Every number in the research slides, with its year, unit and limits.
slides.purpose_ja: 出典を聞かれたときの補足。各数字の年、単位、定義と、使えない比べ方を並べる。
lines: Seven rows: figure, source, definition and caution
